title: 10 graduate runway looks: which direction stands out to you?
text:
These looks come from **Fashion Design graduates** at **Istituto Marangoni** who presented their collections during Milan Fashion Week 2025.

Each explored a **distinct direction**:

– **Beatricia Rotaru — A ME VEL PRO ME**  
A theatrical meditation on destiny.

– **Giorgia Candida Sorbillo — VADO. C’È L’ALTALENA LIBERA**  
Playful, experimental silhouettes inspired by Sottsass and Pippi Longstocking,

– **Maresia Cristini — RESTO IN SOSPESO**  
An emotional mosaic where contrast and harmony coexist.

– **Marco Tulli — OTIA LIBERRIMA**  
A reimagining of classic menswear.

– **Jacopo Maria Arena — DIVERSO**  
Inspired by the Platonic myth of the androgynous.

– **Vittorio Tinti — GALLERIA 67**  
A dialogue between Brutalism, nature, and the memory of Arte Povera.

– **Kyunghoe Ku — RIBELLIONE LEGACY**  
Deconstructing military codes.

– **Katsiaryna Yermakova — RESIDUE**  
A search for “home” across childhood memories and seascapes.

– **Asia Pecorini — PSICOFORME**  
Visionary volumes shaping a dreamlike yet minimal elegance.

– **Giuseppina Lamiranda — ANCESTRAL RHYTHMS**  
A journey into roots through rhythm and memory.

 

**Which of these feels most aligned with where fashion is heading next season?**
